construction: ChatGPT created balanced controlled citation-support and cross-claim relation cases from propositions and evidence chunks in the two frozen held-out papers. Labels were authored after DATA-05B threshold selection and were not used to tune the model, prompts or frozen warning threshold.
permitted_claim: The labels support descriptive held-out engineering measurements for citation validation and contradiction warnings.
limitations: The benchmark is small and uses one AI annotator.
Most cases are controlled perturbations rather than naturally occurring citation errors or cross-paper disputes.
The two source papers are both computer-science papers and do not represent other disciplines.
